title: Email-address structural test vectors
description: Deterministic fixture of email candidates paired with structural rejection reasons. Mirrors the Swift ``detectEmails`` regex at PIIDetector.swift:451 (pattern declared at :447-449) plus the inline RFC 5321 ``> 254 chars`` cap at :454-455.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the format changes in a way that requires a Swift-side decoder update.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

seed.description: PRNG seed used to generate this artifact, recorded for reproducibility.

vectors.description: Test vectors. Each record is one email candidate with its expected structural verdict.

email.description: Email candidate. Valid vectors match the Swift email regex AND fall under the 254-character cap; invalid vectors deliberately deviate.

valid.description: Whether the candidate is accepted by both the regex shape and the RFC 5321 length cap.

rejection_reason.description: Which structural rule rejects this email, or null if valid.
